result.title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
result.summary: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NoeVera，一个面向 LLM 服务系统配置优化的 agentic「第二大脑」：将论文、代码、基准与实验结果组织为带来源的持久知识库（源证据、可复用综合、agent 记忆三层），由决策感知检索组装证据包、按角色分工推理并按需调用模拟器，再把结论写回为限定适用范围的证据记录。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「决策还缺少哪些证据」的检索、模拟器调用预算下的配置搜索与停止，以及带来源和适用范围限定的证据写回，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的获取和终止判断提供概念参照，但任务领域为服务系统调优，可供核查迁移价值。
